title: Cappadocia to Antalya: Direct Flights vs Scenic Drive via Konya
seoTitle: Cappadocia to Antalya: Flights vs Konya Drive (2026)
metaDescription: Compare direct Kayseri–Antalya flights against driving via Sultanhanı and Konya, including winter Taurus Pass advice and family luggage tips.
quickAnswer: Direct 80-minute flights from Kayseri Erkilet Airport (ASR) to Antalya (AYT) are the fastest cappadocia to antalya transport option, cutting door-to-door travel to around four hours. Driving via Sultanhanı Caravanserai and Konya takes 6.5 to 7.5 hours non-stop, making it better suited to private-driver sightseeing days between April and November.

body.text: Are direct Kayseri–Antalya flights seasonal or year-round?

Direct flights between Kayseri Erkilet Airport (ASR) and Antalya Airport (AYT) operate year-round, though weekly frequency expands sharply from April through October. [SunExpress](https://www.sunexpress.com/en-gb/book/book-your-trip/flight-plan/) and [Pegasus Airlines](https://www.flypgs.com/en/domestic-flights) run non-stop services lasting roughly 1 hour 20 minutes, while Nevşehir Kapadokya Airport (NAV) rarely offers direct Antalya departures.

During summer, travellers can usually choose between morning and late-afternoon non-stop departures on the [ASR–AYT corridor](https://www.flightsfrom.com/ASR-AYT). Between November and March, schedules thin to select days of the week, often pushing off-season travellers onto one-stop connections via Istanbul (IST or SAW) if their departure date does not align. Because Göreme, Ürgüp, and Uçhisar sit 65 to 75 minutes by road from Kayseri Airport, factor in an early hotel pickup plus 90 minutes for domestic check-in.
How long is the drive via Sultanhanı Caravanserai and Konya?

Driving from central Cappadocia (Göreme or Ürgüp) to central Antalya via Aksaray, Sultanhanı, Konya, and the D695 Taurus corridor covers roughly 540 kilometres and takes 6.5 to 7.5 hours of pure driving. Adding visits to Sultanhanı Caravanserai and Konya's Mevlana Museum turns the transfer into a full 9-to-10-hour overland day.

The central Anatolian steppe across Aksaray and Konya is flat, dual-carriageway driving, which keeps speeds steady and fatigue low. Stopping at the 13th-century Sultanhanı Caravanserai breaks up the first two hours, while Konya provides an ideal lunch stop near the Mevlana complex before the road climbs toward Seydişehir and the Taurus Mountains. Once you descend to the Mediterranean plain near Manavgat, coastal traffic toward Lara, Belek, or Kaleiçi adds 30 to 60 minutes depending on your hotel zone.

body.text: Which route works best for families with luggage?

For families carrying multiple large suitcases, strollers, or car seats, a private transfer van via Konya or a direct ASR–AYT flight with pre-booked hold luggage are the two most practical choices. Intercity coaches and connecting flights through Istanbul add extra terminal transfers that quickly exhaust younger children.

If you fly, review your carrier's domestic baggage bundle carefully before booking: [Pegasus Airlines](https://www.flypgs.com/en/pegasus-baggage-allowance) charges separately for hold bags on basic fares, whereas full-service or upgraded bundles include 15–20 kg checked allowances. On arrival at [Antalya Airport (AYT)](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/passengers-visitors/transportation), pre-arranged private transfers meet you outside the domestic terminal and run straight to Belek, Lara, or Kemer without shuttle stops. A private Mercedes Vito or Sprinter overland costs more than economy airfare for two, yet for four to six travellers it often rivals the combined cost of four flight tickets, checked bags, and two airport transfers.

items: Confirm whether your hotel pickup is timed for Kayseri (ASR, 65–75 min) rather than Nevşehir (NAV, 40–45 min).
Pre-book infant or child seats in writing for both airport transfers and private Konya overland vans.
Reserve checked baggage weight online at least 24 hours before flying ASR–AYT to avoid airport counter surcharges.
Pack a light jacket in cabin bags when moving between Cappadocia's cool high plateau and Antalya's humid coast.

body.text: When are Taurus Mountain passes affected by winter snow?

The D695 highway crosses the Taurus Mountains at Alacabel Pass (1,825 metres elevation), where heavy snowfall, black ice, and fog regularly disrupt traffic between late December and mid-March. According to the [General Directorate of Highways (KGM)](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/YolDanisma/GunlukYolDurumuBulteni.aspx), winter storms can trigger temporary closures for heavy vehicles and require snow chains or winter tyres for passenger cars.

While KGM is advancing the 7.4-kilometre [Alacabel Tunnel project](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/Duyurular/DuyuruDetay.aspx?Parameter=2096) to bypass the highest exposed ridge, drivers crossing in winter 2026–2027 should still check live advisories on the [KGM closed-roads portal](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/YolDanisma/TrafigeKapaliYollar.aspx) before leaving Konya. If snow is forecast over Alacabel, flying ASR–AYT or routing west via Isparta is safer than risking a multi-hour mountain hold.

faq.q: Can I fly directly from Nevşehir (NAV) to Antalya?
faq.a: Direct scheduled flights between Nevşehir (NAV) and Antalya (AYT) are rarely operated; almost all direct Cappadocia–Antalya flights depart from Kayseri Erkilet Airport (ASR).

faq.q: How early should I leave Göreme for a morning Kayseri flight?
faq.a: Plan to depart Göreme at least 3 hours before takeoff—allowing 70 minutes for the road transfer to ASR and 90–110 minutes for bag drop and security.

faq.q: Is Sultanhanı Caravanserai open year-round on the Konya route?
faq.a: Yes, Sultanhanı sits directly along the D300 highway between Aksaray and Konya and typically takes 30 to 45 minutes to visit during a daytime road transfer.

faq.q: Do rental cars from Cappadocia allow one-way drop-off in Antalya?
faq.a: Most major rental agencies at Kayseri Airport allow one-way drop-offs at Antalya Airport, though they charge a one-way relocation fee that varies by season.

faq.q: Are winter tyres mandatory when driving from Cappadocia to Antalya in January?
faq.a: Türkiye mandates winter tyres on commercial passenger vehicles from December through April, and private drivers crossing Alacabel Pass in winter should insist on fitted winter tyres.

faq.q: Is the overnight bus from Cappadocia to Antalya comfortable?
faq.a: Modern Turkish coaches offer reclining seats and scheduled rest stops, but the 9-to-10-hour overnight ride arrives early at Antalya Otogar and leaves families tired on arrival day.
